cases.title: Offline acknowledgement is required before any guard change
Missing E2 and self-session backend refuses partial guard installation
An ordinary API role cannot install the candidate even with its offline acknowledgement
A changed routine grant stops installation before modifying any guarded function
Actual full-source integration installs 148 guards and 82 restrictive policies with protected metadata assertions
Reinstallation refuses to stack guards or replace an existing integration
All 82 named policies are restrictive, authenticated-only and cover both USING and WITH CHECK
Every original public function retains OID, ACL, arguments, defaults, result, volatility and settings
Every one of the 148 actual application entrypoints denies a password-only session before original logic
Every anonymously callable guarded entrypoint denies the actual anonymous role
Unverified existing Personal rows, Business profiles, Admin directory and private file are not released
Forged service, Admin, AAL2 and client verification claims do not bypass the actual authenticated role
Public catalogue, signup currencies and market rates remain available to anonymous and unverified users
The five reviewed public or pure exceptions retain their exact source bodies
The service-only mail-challenge path can establish proof while application gates are enforced
A different session of the same account remains denied after the first session verifies
Verified Personal access retains ownership isolation and the actual provisioning RPC works
Verified one-time-payment RPC preserves its nested entitlement, ownership and finance checks
Actual direct-table UPDATE works after proof and the unverified same-account session has no effect
Unverified direct INSERT cannot use correct owner and workspace values to bypass WITH CHECK
Private Storage metadata access requires proof and still enforces original path ownership
Business owner permissions and role snapshot work after proof without granting the foreign Business
All 36 converted SQL functions execute behind proof with original NULL-input semantics or purpose denials
A verified ordinary account remains non-Admin and receives no rows from the Admin subscription monitor
A platform Admin must verify first and then retains its existing role-based directory access
A genuine modeled service SET ROLE and service JWT retain permitted helper and scheduler paths
Service-only scheduler ACL remains unavailable to authenticated and anonymous callers
The new private application-context helper is not directly callable by any API role
Password invalidation immediately denies actual application RPC and table access again
Verified owner deletion still cascades the selected record conversion through the existing FK
Modeled Auth middleware signup callback still creates an unverified new Personal account
An unprivileged direct SQL pool identity receives no trusted-internal exemption
